name: Iri Vale
title: Relay dispatcher
dialogue: Six families just came through the gate, and Nella’s kitchen has no water. Get Oru’s welcome record, then meet me back here. We’ll get the feed running.

name: Sera Quill
title: Memory witness
dialogue: The kitchen’s donors have been charged twice. I need the original shutoff notice so we can challenge the bill and reopen the feed.

name: Bram Cinder
title: Foundry steward
dialogue: The kitchen pump works. The account lock is stopping the water. Pick up the job sheet and I’ll explain the bypass.

name: Ves of the Quiet
title: Null Choir listener
dialogue: The kitchen’s water was shut off without a warning people could use. Help me restore the feed and set up a warning light.

name: Oru
title: Lineage archivist
dialogue: What name should I put in the record? Your faction contact is helping Nella reopen the kitchen. Take this along and bring it back when you’re done.

name: Patch
title: Street quartermaster
dialogue: Medkits on the left, coils on the right. Bring the old casing back if it isn't fused. I can knock something off the next repair.

name: Mara Venn
title: Fen pump delegate
dialogue: The well dropped another handspan. My father's buying water from the pump I work. Check the gauge; I need the number before tonight's shift meeting.

name: Tovin Ash
title: Cinderwood cutter
dialogue: That stand behind me is still alive. The ledger says it's salvage. Check the entry before they send another cutting crew.

name: Ada Silt
title: Steppe kiln keeper
dialogue: My partner's shell is cracked. There's enough mineral below the well to replace it. Read the soil core before you tell me to dig.

name: Ilex Marr
title: Brine culture keeper
dialogue: Don't open the jars. The cultures inside are stable. The stuff on the houses isn't. If you're staying, help me mark the new boundary.

name: Nella Rook
title: Commons kitchen keeper
dialogue: Fourteen bowls stayed empty yesterday. I kept them here. Bring the water back, then help me find the people who could not afford to come.

name: Elin Voss
title: Glass Steps cooling steward
dialogue: The premium cabinets are cold, but patients’ memories are warming up. Help me check who gets cooling first and why.

name: Merek Tan
title: Copper Walk repair delegate
dialogue: An empty office gets heat all day while twenty-three flats freeze. My crew can redirect it, but the repair form would leave an apprentice paying the old debt.

name: Sable Ren
title: Listening Courts access keeper
dialogue: We disconnected the advertising speakers and lost our flood warning too. Help me test a warning lamp and a vibrating handrail.

name: Ivo Pell
title: Last Connection platform steward
dialogue: Forty night workers used this connection, but the counter recorded zero passengers. Help me find where it excludes service passes before they close the route.
